name: EPIC 206006113

text.card: A red giant 3,482 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.94 solar masses and 10.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,985 K at its surface.
